messages:
Alex: PSA: I left a half-eaten taco in the kitchen fridge at 00:07. It is now officially a meme.
Jo: Midnight tacos are sacred. Who was the brave soul? :taco:
Lina: That was me. I pledge to bring full tacos next time. Also proposing we crown a 'Midnight Taco King' for the week.
Carlos: Nominate Lina. She has my vote. She also sent the '2 AM deploy fix' gif.
Naveen: Does the Taco King get a parking spot or just moral authority?
Alex: Moral authority + one reserved spot for late-night snack runs.
Jo: OpsBot: Reminder: shared-fridge items older than 48 hours will be cleared. Also please label leftovers.
Lina: Will label "Lina's midnight tacos" and add a tiny paper crown.
Carlos: Tiny crown + sticky note = instant lore. We should put a small plaque on the fridge: "In taco we trust."
Jo: New nickname suggestion: "Lina, Keeper of the Tacos"
Naveen: Alternative: "Taco Overlord". Might scare the interns.
Alex: Intern-friendly variant: "Snack Steward".
PeopleOps: Heads-up: if this turns into a recurring tradition, please file a small on-site event note so facilities can accommodate.
Lina: Will file (with a tasteful taco emoji). Also curious: who else is on emergency taco duty?
Carlos: I can rotate in. My specialty is guac diplomacy.
Jo: Important rule: no glitter on tacos. We learned that last holiday.
Alex: I volunteer to craft a ceremonial valet box for the crown (aka a cereal box painted gold).
Naveen: Side bet: who can finish a full midnight taco without spilling salsa on their hoodie?
Jo: Lina has a 90% success rate. I have a 12% success rate.
PeopleOps: Please remember food allergies in the channel when bringing shared snacks. Also, small reminder to wash hands after handling communal items.
Carlos: Agreed. Also: can we have a photo wall? Caption: "Night Shift Legends".
Lina: If we get a photo wall, I demand a professionally bad portrait of the Taco King.
Alex: Challenge accepted. I'll bring props (fake mustache optional).
Jo: OpsBot: Fun fact: "taco" currently appears in 27 company threads.
Naveen: This is officially a recurring lore thread. Filing under "culture" in my brain.
Lina: OK team, next taco night: next Friday, 23:30. Bring napkins, bravery, and labelling stickers.
Carlos: Will bring extra guac. Also, someone remind me to not leave half tacos in the fridge next time.
Alex: Photo at 23:45 is a must. We'll vote for Taco King via emoji reaction.
Jo: I call dibs on creating a sash (recyclable materials).
PeopleOps: Noted! If the tradition grows, we'll coordinate with facilities for napkins and plates.
Lina: Thank you all. See you at 23:30. Long live the midnight taco. :taco::crown:
